title_zh: 约定先征求志愿者同意再准备提名

scenario.label_zh: 约定先征求志愿者同意再准备提名
scenario.goal_zh: 确认奖项需要被提名者同意，并分工先询问意愿、获准后整理提名材料

context_zh: 社区中心的两名志愿者讨论为同伴申请志愿服务奖。
author: author-phase11-c

sentences.speaker: Bruno
sentences.text: I’d like to nominate Jo for the community service award. She’s kept the evening sessions running all year.

sentences.speaker: Hazel
sentences.text: Does the nominee have to agree first? Jo doesn’t always like being in the spotlight.

sentences.speaker: Bruno
sentences.text: Yes. The nomination form asks for her consent, so we can’t just surprise her with it.

sentences.speaker: Hazel
sentences.text: I know her well. I can ask privately whether she’d be comfortable with it.

sentences.speaker: Bruno
sentences.text: Please do. If she agrees, I’ll collect the session records and write the explanation.

sentences.speaker: Hazel
sentences.text: And if she says no, we’ll leave it there.

sentences.speaker: Bruno
sentences.text: Absolutely. Let’s ask her before we prepare the application.
